trademark mark

The mark a trademark protects. Functional.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Trademark -> gmeow:Mark; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:trademarkMark from gmeow:Trademark to gmeow:Mark when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to bind the protected sign to its gmeow:Trademark relator — the mark-side player of the trademark.

Avoid when

  • Avoid binding several marks to one trademark (it is functional — each protected mark has its own Trademark relator) and avoid using it as the entity-to-trademark link, which is gmeow:hasTrademark.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:trademarkMark once per Trademark (functional) to the gmeow:Mark it protects.

Examples

  • ex:blackcatTM gmeow:trademarkMark ex:blackcatMark.
